parole.motivo_incerta: Uncertain; Possibly; perhaps; alternatively; modello unc/uncertain
parole.testo: Uncertain. An early use is in Fernão Mendes Pinto's 1614 Peregrinação. Possibly a corruption of Chinese 龍船 /龙船 (lóngchuán) (in Cantonese: /lʊŋ²¹ ʃyːn²¹/), although the phonological and semantic differences are significant. Alternatively, perhaps related in some way to lancha.

parole.significato: spring roll (shredded vegetables wrapped in a pancake)
parole.testo: Calque of Chinese 春捲 /春卷 (chūnjuǎn)

parole.significato: paper tiger (a seemingly fierce or powerful person, country or organisation)
parole.testo: Calque from Chinese 紙老虎／纸老虎 (zhǐlǎohǔ).
